market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH trades at ~$2,315 on May 9 2026 with recent floor support near $2,211. A dip to $1,500 requires a 35% drawdown by Dec 31 — 7+ months of runway. ETH has shown high volatility historically and a major risk-off event could plausibly drive that move, but base rate for >30% drop within 7 months from current price is below 50%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro shock or ETH-specific bearish catalyst over 7 months
